parsing.colAvailabilityHint: The server probes parser catalog URLs with HTTP GET (which URLs depends on PLP vs PDP). Green means all probed pages succeeded; red means none; yellow means some. Refreshes when you save the schedule or use Run now, and periodically for active schedules (roughly every 10+ minutes).
parsing.registrySyncInfo999md: Rebuilds the 999.md import registry and partner fields on Kupito listings by matching live profile ads (GraphQL) against your vehicle listings in the database (VIN first, then a strict fingerprint). Only unambiguous matches are written. Requires the same import credentials on the server as CLI import.
parsing.registrySyncInfoCipauto: Seeds the CipAuto import registry from existing Kupito listings for this partner user, using Cod produs from listing descriptions and updating partner fields. Does not read the PLP snapshot; safe to run after a fresh PLP scan.
parsing.registrySyncAssignedUserHint: Must be the partner account whose listings are matched. Prefilled when a recent PDP/PLP run used this PLP file with an assigned user.
parsing.registrySyncLoginMismatch: The login stored in this PLP file does not match the file name. Fix the snapshot or pick the correct file.
parsing.assignUserRequired: Validate the assigned user before starting
parsing.everyNDaysRequired: Please set interval from 1 to 30 days
parsing.runNowSkipped: Run was not started (conflict or unavailable)
parsing.fieldAssignedUserHint: Enter the UUID of the user who will own listings created or updated by this parsing process. The UUID can be copied from the Users section in the admin panel.
parsing.fieldResumeHint: Continues the latest unfinished run for this parser so processing does not restart from scratch.
parsing.fieldDryRunHint: Runs the process in test mode without applying final changes so you can inspect logs and results first.
parsing.fieldOnlyFailedHint: Processes only items that failed in the previous run.
parsing.fieldUpdateExistingHint: Updates existing listings with matching identifiers instead of skipping them.
parsing.fieldCheckUserDuplicatesBeforeCreateHint: Before creating a new listing, load the partner user's vehicle rows from the database and skip create when a duplicate is found (parser-specific rules). Requires DB access from the import process.
parsing.fieldRemoveClosed: Close listings when source is unavailable

partners.title: For partners
partners.intro: We invite companies to partner with Kupito. Below is a short summary of the program: how to join, what you get and how to leave.

howToBecome.title: How to become a partner
items: Write to us via the Contacts page and briefly describe your business.
Only accounts registered on the platform as legal entities can take part.
We will reply and, if needed, help set up automatic listing sync with your website or other platforms.

benefits.title: What partnership gives you
items: Automatic listing synchronization with your website or other platforms, with no manual duplication.
Free promotion bonuses: one credit for every 20 of your new listings. Status and balance are shown in your profile.
On My Listings you spend the balance yourself by turning on free promotion for any listing you choose.
A partner badge on your listing pages and on your public listings board.
Your logo and link in the Kupito footer.

whoCan.title: Who can become a partner
items: Only users registered on the platform as a legal entity (when you sign up, choose registration on behalf of a company, not as an individual).
Private sellers do not take part in the program.

howToLeave.title: How to end the partnership
items: Contact us via the Contacts page and say you want to end the partnership.
We remove partner status, take you out of the footer and clear the accumulated free promotions.
Full conditions on status and bonuses are in the Terms of Service.

obligations.title: Expectations and recommendations
items: Partnership does not add financial or legal duties beyond what is described in the service and the Terms.
We appreciate mentions of Kupito on your websites and social media, and referrals from you when a customer wants to sell a car but you are not buying it.

investors.title: For investors
investors.intro: Kupito.club is a platform for car sale listings, focused on simplicity, automation, and scale.

about.title: About the project
paragraphs: The project is built on the idea that the maturity of a car-classifieds market tracks the level of a country’s economy and IT market. Mature countries tend to have convenient, product-led platforms, while in less developed markets the experience is often dated and clunky.
Kupito.club addresses this by building a universal core that lets a modern listing platform be launched in any country in a matter of days.

done.title: What we have so far
items: A live platform in Moldova as a test market
A listing system with a modern user interface
Initial partners, including car dealers
Automatic listing synchronization
Early traffic and first users

product.title: Product
items: Free listing publication
Easy search and comparison of listings
Saving listings to favorites
Saving search filters
The option to get short AI-generated informational summaries for eligible vehicle listings (signed-in users; subject to availability and limits)
A seller listing board with all of one seller’s listings on a single page
Automatic synchronization with external sites
A mobile-first interface and ongoing mobile app development

businessModel.title: Business model
items: Paid listing promotion
On-platform advertising
Premium subscriptions with more features
B2B tools for dealers

vision.title: Vision
paragraphs: Build universal infrastructure for car listings that can be rolled out and adapted to any market quickly.

strategy.title: Growth strategy
items: Validating the model in Moldova
Scaling marketing
Growing the partner network of dealers
Expanding to new markets

scaling.title: Scaling
scaling.lead: After the model is validated, we plan launches in other countries with similar market conditions:
items: Eastern Europe
Balkans
Latin America
Africa
Asia

whyNow.title: Why now
items: The car-listings market remains fragmented
Many countries still lack a modern product
We can move fast on niche leadership through launch speed and product quality

offer.title: Investment offer
items: Scale marketing
Accelerate product development
Enter new markets
